quest.title: Radiant Harvest: Compensation
quest.description: The deadline for retrieving the Violetglow Jellyfish is nearing. It's time to check in on how Kesean's doing...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Unknown Item #363355 x1

dialogues.speaker: Kesean
dialogues.text: Hey! You're back. You missed out on something hilarious just now!

dialogues.speaker: Kesean
dialogues.text: Just now, I brought the retrieved jellyfish and waited here for Mr. Augereau's inspection. But before he could show up, some of my buyers did.

dialogues.speaker: Kesean
dialogues.text: They told me that ever since releasing the first several batches of jellyfish, they felt refreshed, and their business has been going super well. They thought it must have been a blessing from the heavens for doing a good deed! So they came back to buy more to release.

choices.text: I'm still trying to catch them for you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... {NICKNAME} catches them, Mr. Kesean sells them, and buyers release them again... Hey! Is this your way of making money!?

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: What!? No! How could I!? I don't want any more trouble with the Gardes!

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: Ahem... I spent ages telling them that releasing these jellyfish does more harm than good, but they simply wouldn't listen!

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: They just believe that their luck was due to... what they consider to be a good deed.

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: They even believe that my bad luck was due to keeping the jellyfish in captivity. *sigh* Just what are they thinking...

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: Anyway, while we argued, Mr. Augereau arrived and immediately took them into custody.

choices.text: Guess their luck had run out.

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: ...In the end, was carelessly releasing these creatures without first understanding their habits and ecology really for the creatures, or just for their own good luck?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They were also taken into custody by the Gardes... Seems like they didn't get much luck out of it in the end.

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: Ha! Speaking of which, thanks to you, the Gardes have now waived my jail sentence.

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: In addition to the compensation I promised you, I also have a little memento for you. Please, take it.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Kesean takes out a jellyfish ball...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehh?? Are these... also Violetglow Jellyfish? Why do they look so much smaller than the ones we caught before...

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: Yep, they are smaller specimens. I picked out a few suitable specimens from the storage warehouse yesterday. There were more specimens than there were assignment numbers, though, so I figured I might as well give you some as a memento.

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: As for the rest, I'll continue breeding them and find a way to integrate them into natural environments.

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: Oh, and I'm also planning on keeping a few of the Violetglow Jellyfish to investigate their clustering and glowing behavior.

choices.text: Well, they do look pretty cute...

response.speaker: Kesean
response.text: W—Woah, wait! Don't you dare to think about releasing them!!!

choices.text: I think they would look cuter swimming in the water...
How are you still selling them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've already caught lots of jellyfish. Paimon wonders how the ecological recovery Kesean mentioned is going...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go check on him! Hopefully he hasn't been taken away by the Gardes...
